summary: Master Data Governance and MDM with our expert-led course. Gain essential knowledge and tools to manage data effectively and drive business success.
lede: Data Governance and Master Data Management provides a structured approach to treating data as a strategic asset, aligning policy, technology, decision rights, and accountability with business objectives. You will learn to establish a governance charter, design multi-domain MDM architectures, profile data quality, manage metadata lifecycles, and apply privacy by design. The course takes a practitioner-led approach to creating a unified view of customers, products, and suppliers while addressing budget constraints and stakeholder resistance. Through hands-on data profiling and MDM technology selection criteria, you will build the capabilities to make data more accurate, consistent, and ready for AI-driven decisions and automated workflows.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for experienced professionals responsible for the integrity and strategic utility of enterprise information assets.
modules: Measuring Data Governance Value and ROI
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3-5 years of experience in data management, IT audit, or business analysis. Familiarity with SQL and basic database concepts is required. Prior exposure to the DAMA-DMBOK® framework or COBIT® principles is beneficial but not mandatory.
